value.account:
CHANGED
- New leaf modules: workflow/resume_slots.py (slot enumeration, loop bookkeeping validation with the specified messages, id/boundary resolution), workflow/resume_retry_lineage.py (index_retry_lineage, next_unused_retry_frame_id, errors), workflow/resume_projection_integrity.py (ResumeScopePath, audit_scope, diagnostic builder; imports no migration/retirement code), orchestrator/import_alias_audit.py (YAML node-graph duplicate alias / duplicate imports-section detection with line/column).
- state_projection: CallBoundaryProjection.import_alias, WorkflowStateProjection.enumerate_resume_slots / resolve_resume_step_id / resolve_call_boundary, re-exported ResumeProjectionValidationError. lowering registers the alias.
- StateManager.record_workflow_checksum_mismatch / record_resume_projection_integrity_failure: edit the raw state.json, so only status/error/updated_at change and unknown root fields survive.
- resume CLI: audit_scope after checksum acceptance and before observability writes, session/process metadata, executor construction; exit 1, stderr reason. Session close failure is logged and cannot replace the diagnostic.
- WorkflowExecutor: structural-root guard (checksum recheck via calculate_checksum with the four reasons, then audit_scope) before the prologue; child frame executors skip it. A pending/pinned sticky projection error makes _handle_control_flow return _stop before any goto/on_error logic, pins state['error'], and stops for_each iteration (loops.py). Finalization failures are supplemental (failure.error is the cleanup's projection error or null) and never replace the run diagnostic; a projection error arising only in finalization becomes the run error.
- calls.py: reached calls resolve the boundary with exactly one resolve_call_boundary, take the callee from the boundary's alias, then (after input/write-root validation) pick the frame from the retry lineage, run running-member checksum+bound-input validation, failed-predecessor checksum+recursive audit, running-member audit, all before _CallFrameStateManager/child executor. Completed-frame id collision is rejected with the exact call_resume_state_invalid context. Child projection errors are returned unwrapped (never call_failed). _is_workflow_lisp_target is now frontend_kind based; the name/suffix retry-family helpers are gone.
- Typed provenance: Workflow Lisp lowering passes frontend_kind to surface elaboration; build_frontend_bundle no longer overwrites it.
- Observability: forensic current_step (failed run with projection/checksum envelope error) renders as pending in build_status_snapshot, and is ignored by heartbeat in monitor messages, dashboard projection and the state-only report.
- Specs: new section in specs/state.md and acceptance entries 201-209.
- Tests: new tests/test_resume_projection_integrity.py (53+ behavioural tests). Existing tests updated where the contract legitimately changed: characterization tests in test_resume_command/test_subworkflow_calls now assert the new order and delta; fixtures that lacked current_step.step_id got one; tests that resume compile_stage3 bundles directly now carry a legacy lowering-schema context (they are now correctly classified as Workflow Lisp); the adjudication changed-config case bypasses the root guard because editing source is now a checksum failure; a lexical-restore bookkeeping-drift test now expects the earlier audit rejection; two structural goldens gained call-boundary import_alias.

VERIFICATION
Focused suites pass. Full suite (-n 16): every remaining failure is also failing on the untouched baseline (checked by stashing); one xdist-only flake passed in isolation on both trees. CLI smoke: ran a real failed run, corrupted a step_id, `orchestrator resume` exits 1, persists only status/error/updated_at with unknown_explicit_step_id. Nothing was committed.

ALTERNATIVES / DECISIONS
- Putting declared repeat_until maxima into the projection tables was tried and dropped: it changes serialized projection goldens. enumerate_resume_slots takes an optional max_iterations_by_frame_key kwarg that the auditor fills from the bundle IR; without it only maximum-free checks (negative index etc.) apply.
- The auditor calls the resume_slots functions directly rather than the projection methods so resolve_call_boundary is invoked exactly once per reached call.
- An absent loop frame row with terminal exhaustion progress is accepted (an existing lexical-restore test depends on it); a present but wrong row is rejected.
- CLI audit is skipped for already-completed runs so a completed run is never flipped to failed.
- Unknown-alias check on the step's own call alias stays first (existing test), then the boundary's alias takes over in resume mode.
- Sticky handling uses an executor-level pending/pinned flag set where _execute_call returns, instead of threading a type check through every routing site.

NOT COVERED / RISKS
- Loops nested inside loop bodies: only first-level loop-local rows and call boundaries are enumerated, so deeper rows with an explicit step_id would fail as unclaimed.
- Hidden-test guesses: scope-path workflow_file for expected_owner uses str(bundle provenance path); out-of-range for_each current_index message is "for_each.X.current_index is out of range" (not in the given list); reached-call boundary failures use field null.
- for_each legacy (non-typed) body path got the sticky stop but is only exercised indirectly; no end-to-end test of a real nested projection error through finalization or a loop, only unit-level tests of the control-flow and finalization hooks.
- Docs index/capability matrix were not updated; no commit made.
value.summary: Resume now audits every persisted identity (steps, current step, loop progress, call frames, Workflow Lisp retry lineage) against the current projection at the CLI, the structural root executor and each reached call, failing closed with a sticky resume_projection_integrity_error; duplicate YAML import aliases and typed Workflow Lisp provenance are in too, and the full suite shows no regressions against baseline.
